summary: Lust is designed with subdued contemporary styling characterised by it's soft curves above a subtle skirt which gives the bath an illusion of weightlessness. Read more to find out why Lust is our Best Selling Freestanding Bath.
title: Unwind In Luxury - Our Best Selling Bath
bodyHtml:
The Lust Bath Series

Create a haven of indulgence with our best-selling freestanding bath, designed to be the centrepiece of your space.

Crafted from 100% silica-free Marmotech — Studio Bagno’s exclusive stone composite formulation — the Lust bath combines unparalleled beauty with exceptional comfort.

Explore Our Bath Collection

A Statement of Style

Defined by its soft curves atop a subtle skirting, Lust exudes an air of weightlessness, elevating the aesthetic of any bathroom.

Available in Matte White, Semi-Gloss White and Ash Grey finishes, it complements both contemporary and classic interiors with ease. For added functionality, the back-to-wall option retains the same elegance while offering a practical shelf space for everyday essentials.

Comfort and Hygiene

Marmotech isn’t just about looks—it’s about how it feels. Quick to warm and luxuriously smooth to the touch, this non-porous surface ensures hygiene without compromise. It’s easy to clean with just warm water and biodegradable detergent, staying pristine with minimal effort.

Your Everyday Escape

Lust is more than just a bath; it’s an invitation to slow down, unwind, and recapture precious moments in your busy day. A perfect blend of luxury and functionality, Lust redefines what a daily retreat can be.
